def hdiff(in_field: Float[Array, '15 15 10'], out_field: Float[Array, '11 11 10'], coeff: Float[Array, '11 11 10']):
    bprobe_trace = []
    I, J, K = (out_field.shape[0], out_field.shape[1], out_field.shape[2])
    bprobe_v0 = in_field[1:I + 3, 1:J + 3, :]
    bprobe_trace.append((4, bprobe_v0))
    bprobe_v1 = 4.0 * bprobe_v0
    bprobe_trace.append((3, bprobe_v1))
    bprobe_v2 = in_field[2:I + 4, 1:J + 3, :]
    bprobe_trace.append((8, bprobe_v2))
    bprobe_v3 = in_field[0:I + 2, 1:J + 3, :]
    bprobe_trace.append((9, bprobe_v3))
    bprobe_v4 = bprobe_v2 + bprobe_v3
    bprobe_trace.append((5, bprobe_v4))
    bprobe_v5 = in_field[1:I + 3, 2:J + 4, :]
    bprobe_trace.append((0, bprobe_v5))
    bprobe_v6 = bprobe_v4 + bprobe_v5
    bprobe_trace.append((6, bprobe_v6))
    bprobe_v7 = in_field[1:I + 3, 0:J + 2, :]
    bprobe_trace.append((1, bprobe_v7))
    bprobe_v8 = bprobe_v6 + bprobe_v7
    bprobe_trace.append((7, bprobe_v8))
    bprobe_v9 = bprobe_v1 - bprobe_v8
    bprobe_trace.append((2, bprobe_v9))
    lap_field = bprobe_v9
    bprobe_v10 = lap_field[1:, 1:J + 1, :]
    bprobe_trace.append((10, bprobe_v10))
    bprobe_v11 = lap_field[:-1, 1:J + 1, :]
    bprobe_trace.append((12, bprobe_v11))
    bprobe_v12 = bprobe_v10 - bprobe_v11
    bprobe_trace.append((11, bprobe_v12))
    res = bprobe_v12
    bprobe_v13 = in_field[2:I + 3, 2:J + 2, :]
    bprobe_trace.append((16, bprobe_v13))
    bprobe_v14 = in_field[1:I + 2, 2:J + 2, :]
    bprobe_trace.append((18, bprobe_v14))
    bprobe_v15 = bprobe_v13 - bprobe_v14
    bprobe_trace.append((17, bprobe_v15))
    bprobe_v16 = res * bprobe_v15
    bprobe_trace.append((14, bprobe_v16))
    bprobe_v17 = bprobe_v16 > 0
    bprobe_trace.append((15, bprobe_v17))
    bprobe_v18 = np.where(bprobe_v17, 0, res)
    bprobe_trace.append((13, bprobe_v18))
    flx_field = bprobe_v18
    bprobe_v19 = lap_field[1:I + 1, 1:, :]
    bprobe_trace.append((19, bprobe_v19))
    bprobe_v20 = lap_field[1:I + 1, :-1, :]
    bprobe_trace.append((21, bprobe_v20))
    bprobe_v21 = bprobe_v19 - bprobe_v20
    bprobe_trace.append((20, bprobe_v21))
    res = bprobe_v21
    bprobe_v22 = in_field[2:I + 2, 2:J + 3, :]
    bprobe_trace.append((25, bprobe_v22))
    bprobe_v23 = in_field[2:I + 2, 1:J + 2, :]
    bprobe_trace.append((27, bprobe_v23))
    bprobe_v24 = bprobe_v22 - bprobe_v23
    bprobe_trace.append((26, bprobe_v24))
    bprobe_v25 = res * bprobe_v24
    bprobe_trace.append((23, bprobe_v25))
    bprobe_v26 = bprobe_v25 > 0
    bprobe_trace.append((24, bprobe_v26))
    bprobe_v27 = np.where(bprobe_v26, 0, res)
    bprobe_trace.append((22, bprobe_v27))
    fly_field = bprobe_v27
    bprobe_v28 = in_field[2:I + 2, 2:J + 2, :]
    bprobe_trace.append((31, bprobe_v28))
    bprobe_v29 = coeff[:, :, :]
    bprobe_trace.append((33, bprobe_v29))
    bprobe_v30 = flx_field[1:, :, :]
    bprobe_trace.append((37, bprobe_v30))
    bprobe_v31 = flx_field[:-1, :, :]
    bprobe_trace.append((38, bprobe_v31))
    bprobe_v32 = bprobe_v30 - bprobe_v31
    bprobe_trace.append((34, bprobe_v32))
    bprobe_v33 = fly_field[:, 1:, :]
    bprobe_trace.append((28, bprobe_v33))
    bprobe_v34 = bprobe_v32 + bprobe_v33
    bprobe_trace.append((35, bprobe_v34))
    bprobe_v35 = fly_field[:, :-1, :]
    bprobe_trace.append((29, bprobe_v35))
    bprobe_v36 = bprobe_v34 - bprobe_v35
    bprobe_trace.append((36, bprobe_v36))
    bprobe_v37 = bprobe_v29 * bprobe_v36
    bprobe_trace.append((32, bprobe_v37))
    bprobe_v38 = bprobe_v28 - bprobe_v37
    bprobe_trace.append((30, bprobe_v38))
    out_field[:, :, :] = bprobe_v38
    return bprobe_trace
